description: List the properties the connected person is adding to Fabrica (Ethereum Mainnet), across every wallet on their account, those waiting on them first. Each has its address, county and parcel number, status, how many steps are done, the next step with who acts (the owner, Fabrica, or the county recorder), what it asks and the link to do it, any required details still missing, and the live token once it is live. Needs the connection's onramp:read grant. get_adding_status gives one in full.
name: get_my_properties_being_added
title: Get the properties I'm adding
